newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Hotel Malaysia to sell Boulevard Hotel.
newsitem.headline: Hotel Malaysia to sell Boulevard Hotel.

text.p: Hotel Malaysia Ltd said on Tuesday it had agreed to sell its prime district Boulevard Hotel for Singapore $410 million to a joint venture company led by Hong Leong Holdings Ltd.
It said in a statement, the sale of the hotel would be to Granmil Holdings Pte Ltd a joint venture comprising Hong Leong, City Development Ltd and Lea Investments Pte Ltd.
Hong Leong owns 41 percent, CityDev 40 percent and Lea Investments 19 percent. Lea is owned by Elizabeth Khoo, a director of Hotel Malaysia and other members of the Khoo family.
The Khoo family are major shareholders of Hotel Malaysia.
Granmil has paid an option fee of S$41 million, and the rest will be paid upon completion on July 31.
Hotel Malaysia said revenue from the sale of the hotel site will enable it to obtain greater returns than from its current hotel operations.
It said it had obtained permission for residential development on the Hotel Boulevard site.
